info.title: Kairos Defense API
info.description: Synthetic data only. REST (SPEC §16.4), the replay stream /ws/replay/{incident_id} (§16.3), live mode's ingest /ws/ingest and stream /ws/live/{installation_id} (D-169).

get.description: Matches at a replay second: the latest rerun at or before ``at`` (D-105).
The lens payload: the same shape as the stream's ``dtw`` message (``DtwMsg``).

The matcher trace of a replay incident's rerun at or before ``at`` (D-188): the DTW
workbench's data, the same shape as the stream's ``matcher_trace``. 404 for an unknown
incident, 422 before the first rerun or for a swarm.

A past track's 1 Hz path (ghost trails, phase 8): target-relative or region meters. Live
tracks are refused (rule 3: tonight is not history) until their incident closes and live
mode learns them (D-176): then they are served from the live-mode store.

schema.title: Response History Api History  Track Id  Get

get.description: The newest ``reports/eval_<date>.json`` written by the evaluation harness.

schema.title: Response Eval Latest Api Eval Latest Get

get.description: One ``StreamMessage``: exists so OpenAPI (and the generated types) include every type.
Every case as known at ``as_of`` (default the ledger head), oldest first (D-136).
The case as known at ``as_of`` (transaction time, §15.4; default the ledger head).

schema.title: Response Case Api Cases  Case Id  Get
Response Diff Api Cases  Case Id  Diff Get
Response Graph Api Cases  Case Id  Graph Get

post.description:
An analyst approves or rejects one proposal (rule 8): ``link_approved`` or
``link_rejected``. 404 unknown proposal, 409 wrong case or already decided.

An analyst records a decision on a case (close, reopen, escalate, notify law
enforcement): one ``decision_recorded`` (rule 8: only this explicit action writes it).
422 unknown decision or analyst handle, 404 unknown case.

Export an evidence package (``approve: true`` required, rule 8) and stream the real
hashing progress as NDJSON: one ``EvidenceFileLine`` per file, then ``EvidenceDoneLine``
with the verification checks (or one ``{"type": "error"}`` line).

schema.title: Response 200 Evidence Api Cases  Case Id  Evidence Post

get.description: Exported packages under the exports root, newest first (optionally one case's).

schema.title: Response Evidence List Api Evidence Get

post.description: Re-run the package checks (files, signature, chain, ledger) on an exported package.

schema.title: Response Ledger Tail Api Ledger Tail Get

get.description: The shift delta (§15.8): what the memory learned in ``(since, until]``.

post.description: Empty the ``live_*`` scratch tables (never the ledger), D-010.
Rebuild the ledger from seed (D-010); clients refetch ``/api/ledger/tail`` after it.
A batch of ingest messages for simple adapters (same contract as ``/ws/ingest``).

get.description: Feeds, every live incident since the last reset, the worker queue and the simulator.
The five scenarios with their actor or team choices and bases (for the launcher).

schema.title: Response Live Scenarios Api Live Scenarios Get

post.description:
Remove every live-mode row (detections, incidents, learned history, results, vectors).
The 18-month history and the ledger are untouched (rule 7).

Start the simulator for one scenario as a separate process (D-182). The actor or team is
passed to it and not kept here.

get.description:
Who really flew a closed live incident and how the matcher did (D-170): computed by
``kairos_defense.eval`` on request, never stored. 404 unknown, 409 while open.
The latest live rerun's matcher trace at an installation (D-188); 404 before any.

One ``LiveStreamMessage`` and one ingest message: exists so OpenAPI (and the generated
types) include every live type.

SwarmMatchMsg.title: SwarmMatchMsg
SwarmMatchMsg.description: A live swarm's rerun: the §14 swarm matcher on the drones received so far.

TraceDetail.title: TraceDetail
TraceDetail.description:
One of the first ``trace_paths`` candidates: its warping path (down-sampled, indices into
the full ``n`` × ``m`` matrix), the candidate's curve and a cost-matrix thumbnail.

TracePrefilter.title: TracePrefilter
TracePrefilter.description: Every candidate track in prefilter order (columns line up index by index).
